note: Measured on the POC machine; see REPORT.md. Paths are local to that machine.

region_selection.method: smallest Geofabrik polygon containing each 1 km circle sample (polygon + hole test)

aoi.method: Sentinel-2 SCL classes 3,8,9,10 within circle (20 m)

dem.source: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (AWS Open Data COG, 1 arc-second)
dem.vertical: EGM2008 to EGM96: H96 = H08 + N08 - N96 with NGA geoid grids (cdn.proj.org windows, bilinear on DEM nodes); checked against PROJ cs2cs

skadi_comparison.note: Copernicus GLO-30 (DSM, EGM96-converted) minus Skadi composite (EGM96) at identical 1" nodes; every 4th node in circle

dem.attribution: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018, provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA

landcover.source: ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200 (AWS Open Data COG, windowed read)
landcover.attribution: © ESA WorldCover project 2021 / Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021) processed by ESA WorldCover consortium

imagery.source: Sentinel-2 L2A true-colour (TCI) via Earth Search STAC on AWS Open Data

aoi_quality.method: Sentinel-2 SCL classes 3,8,9,10 within circle (20 m)

imagery.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2026, processed by ESA; catalogue: Element 84 Earth Search

command_baseline.description: Unmodified Command: local PBF import of the same OSM crop + automatic Skadi terrain

commands.cmd: osmium tags-filter --overwrite -o ~/gnss-poc-88-work/runs/cold/_work/filtered.osm.pbf ~/gnss-poc-88-work/runs/cold/osm/area.osm.pbf nwr/highway wr/building nwr/waterway wr/natural nwr/water wr/landuse n/place n/natural=peak,saddle,spring w/aerialway w/railway n/tourism=alpine_hut,wilderness_hut n/amenity=shelter

gdal_translate -of MBTILES -co TILE_FORMAT=PNG -co ZOOM_LEVEL_STRATEGY=LOWER -co NAME=Hillshade (Copernicus GLO-30) -co QUALITY=82 ~/gnss-poc-88-work/runs/cold/_work/hillshade_cut.tif ~/gnss-poc-88-work/runs/cold/dem/hillshade.mbtiles

gdal_translate -of MBTILES -co TILE_FORMAT=PNG -co ZOOM_LEVEL_STRATEGY=LOWER -co NAME=ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 -co QUALITY=82 ~/gnss-poc-88-work/runs/cold/_work/wc_3857.tif ~/gnss-poc-88-work/runs/cold/landcover/worldcover.mbtiles

gdal_translate --config GDAL_DISABLE_READDIR_ON_OPEN EMPTY_DIR -projwin 138159.54417268842 5274336.027703297 192392.5517888581 5219904.411272089 -projwin_srs EPSG:3857 -co COMPRESS=DEFLATE -co TILED=YES /vsicurl/https://sentinel-cogs.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/sentinel-s2-l2a-cogs/31/T/CH/2026/8/S2A_31TCH_20260829_1_L2A/SCL.tif ~/gnss-poc-88-work/cache-final/sources/window-s2-scl-S

gdal_translate --config GDAL_DISABLE_READDIR_ON_OPEN EMPTY_DIR -projwin 138159.54417268842 5274336.027703297 192392.5517888581 5219904.411272089 -projwin_srs EPSG:3857 -co COMPRESS=DEFLATE -co TILED=YES /vsicurl/https://sentinel-cogs.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/sentinel-s2-l2a-cogs/31/T/CG/2026/8/S2B_31TCG_20260829_0_L2A/SCL.tif ~/gnss-poc-88-work/cache-final/sources/window-s2-scl-S
